h: 2Baba says he is 'a changed man' as family saga with Natasha Osawaru continues
p: Singer 2Baba has reportedly opened up on a new personal resolution while the dispute involving his family and Natasha Osawaru continues to attract public attention. He is said to have described himself as a changed man.
more: The singer's family situation has been in the news for months.
Fans are divided in their reactions online.
